svg.title: Annex A10 · Monitoring, alerts and maintenance
svg.desc: Run report, issues by fingerprint, watchdogs, email, keeping scheduled workflows alive and the development tools.
svg.text: Annex A10 · Monitoring, alerts and maintenance

Who finds out when something goes wrong and how. Each run leaves a report; its problems become issues that close themselves, and two independent watchdogs (one on GitHub, one on n8n) look at the live site every 6 hours.
Alerts arrive through GitHub and, if configured, by email.
Details these boxes of the full diagram: GitHub watchdog (watchdog.yml), n8n watchdog (outside GitHub), Incident issues (incidente-datos), Development tools, Maintainers and owner.
what each run and the live site leave behind

g.title: 1. Run report → Issues by fingerprint (sync_issues): warnings and errors.
2. Job results → “The daily update failed”: failure or cancellation.
3. Live site → Watchdog (watchdog.yml): dashboard.json.
4. Live site → n8n watchdog: manifest.json.
5. Issues by fingerprint (sync_issues) → Alert email: opened, closed, recurring.
6. “The daily update failed” → Alert email: recurs.
7. Watchdog (watchdog.yml) → Alert email: its issue changed.
8. n8n watchdog → n8n Error workflow: failed execution. The route that does not depend on GitHub.
9. Alert email → Email recipients: one email per run.
10. n8n Error workflow → Maintainers and owner: alert.
11. Issues by fingerprint (sync_issues) → Maintainers and owner: incidente-datos issues.
12. “The daily update failed” → Maintainers and owner: issue.
13. Watchdog (watchdog.yml) → Maintainers and owner: stale-site issue.
14. Watchdog (watchdog.yml) → Keep workflows alive: re-enables.
15. Maintainers and owner → Development tools: run and review.
Run report. run-report.json lists every warning, error or critical failure with its source, stage, code and fingerprint; it travels as an artifact even if the run fails.

a.title: Annex A9: The site in the browser

g.title: Issues by fingerprint (sync_issues). One incidente-datos issue per fingerprint (source + stage + code), with the fingerprint hidden; it is commented when it recurs and closes itself when it disappears. Technology: Python, GitHub API.
g.text: hidden; it is commented when it recurs and

g.title: “The daily update failed”. Issue opened or commented when a job fails and closed after a good run. Technology: github-script.
g.text: Issue opened or commented when a job fails
and closed after a good run.

g.title: Watchdog (watchdog.yml). Every 6 h (minute 17) it reads the site's dashboard.json. Past 30 h it relaunches the update once every 6 h and opens “The published site is out of date”. Technology: GitHub Actions, cron 17 */6.
g.text: Every 6 h (minute 17) it reads the site's
dashboard.json. Past 30 h it relaunches the
update once every 6 h and opens “The
published site is out of date”.

g.title: Keep workflows alive. GitHub disables scheduled workflows after 60 days without activity: the keepalive job and the watchdog re-enable observatory, watchdog and probe-sources. Technology: API de Actions.
g.text: days without activity: the keepalive job and

g.title: Alert email. tools.alert_email sends a single email per run to ALERT_EMAILS, and only if something opened, closed or recurred. Without SMTP_HOST it does nothing. Technology: SMTP, Python.
g.text: tools.alert_email sends a single email per run
to ALERT_EMAILS, and only if something

g.title: n8n watchdog. Every 6 h it reads data/manifest.json; if it does not answer or is older than 30 h, the execution fails. It works even if all of GitHub is down. Technology: n8n.

g.title: Development tools. ci.yml and n8n.yml (tests), probe-feeds, scrape-ladder, capture-fixtures, device-screens and recolector-kit: they do not publish; they leave bot/ branches and artifacts. Technology: GitHub Actions, pytest, node --test.

If something fails: what happens and which fallback takes over
At 30 h the watchdog relaunches the update and opens an issue; if it
already relaunched within 6 h, it asks for review instead of insisting.
The n8n watchdog keeps watching the site and its Error workflow alerts.
